set.body: Forward-review P0 against ADR 0001 D6. contract.scala:83-109 stores AttemptReceipt.digest as plain Checksum; privacy.scala:45-51 derives PseudonymizedText.digest with ordinary SHA-256 and RemoteCapability carries Checksum at 65-75; baselines.scala:40-62 places plain input/output checksums in ProviderCall even for Sensitive inputs. Executable repro confirms pseudo.digest == Checksum.ofText(policy + NUL + keyId + NUL + text). This leaves dictionary-attackable sensitive receipt surfaces despite MaterialDigest.Sensitive existing. Acceptance: a typed ReceiptDigest distinguishes plain from keyed; every sensitive input/cache/capability/attempt/provider-call identity is HMAC-backed under KeyId with no silent plain fallback; batch receipts preserve per-item sensitivity; same material/different key differs on every sensitive receipt surface; public material stays reproducibly plain; no receipt/log contains text or secret key. Portable JVM/JS/Native laws.
set.title: P0 embed receipts: key every sensitive digest and provider-call identity
